legadoSemantics.implementation: AnalyzeByJSoup delegates compound CSS selection to Jsoup Element.select; comment nodes are not selector candidates.
legadoSemantics.commentBoundary: A comment is consumed as one special node and its markup-like text is never reparsed as an element.

failureCondition: The V2 compound-selector string fallback advances one character after a comment start and can select markup-like text inside the comment as a real element.
